integrity: The finite formula is proved by a first-passage reduction and replayed by exact rational enumeration; numerical root values are supplementary checks rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires almost surely positive pairwise-distinct gap statistics, or an equivalent tie rule exposing single-feature prefixes.
Does not address power or FDR under mixtures of null and non-null features.
Literature search cannot exclude an equivalent result under unsearched terminology.
title: Exact complete-null FDR staircase for simultaneous multi-knockoffs
